selection: Previously verified per-model R execution snapshots, selected before this evaluation
recovery: Retain frozen model-specific recovery rules; all actions, failures and costs retained
learning: Independent workspaces; deterministic public Session construction; no cross-episode learning claim
native_success: Environment-native success; semantic and end-to-end outcomes reported separately
version_note: Original-suite migration of retained LIBERO10 R snapshots; not the historical simplified chain
resource_rule: No preemption. Shared allocator lock, fresh per-card audit, visible claim, own cleanup only
staged_execution: Each group first runs one registered case; full execution skips the same completed identity
technical_retries: Diagnose before one technical retry at most; no measured-failure quality reruns
user_priority: Best observed complete-version physical success; speed secondary; retain every failure and cost
parent_partial_scope: v1 retained separately, not merged into v2 denominator
